source_data: No real machine, vendor, customer or measured plant data

model.load_position_model: Frozen-position snapshots only; no Mdot/Coriolis terms for a continuously moving load

digital.plant_discretization: Exact ZOH for each frozen LTI plant snapshot
digital.delay_location: Integer-sample command path before ZOH plant

evaluation.discrete_stability: All closed-loop eigenvalue magnitudes must be <1
evaluation.small_gain_indicator: 1/max_grid sigma_max(T), sufficient only under the stated stable nominal output-multiplicative full-block small-gain assumptions; grid estimate, not certified H-infinity norm or disk margin
evaluation.caution: No strict multiloop disk margin or structured mu analysis was computed.

notes: Reduced-order synthetic 4-coordinate crossbeam model with assumed bending/torsion modes. Frozen load-position snapshots are not a continuously moving-mass time-varying model. No FE/modal measurement, HIL or hardware evidence. Not a tuning recommendation.
damping_coupling_definition: D_psi_theta = -c, c=0.03*sqrt(D_psi_psi*D_theta_theta); the negative off-diagonal sign follows from the chosen coupling vector [0,1,0,-1]. The scalar c is a synthetic assumed coupling magnitude.
correction_2026_11_22: Corrected the dimensionally inconsistent yaw/torsion cross-damping coefficient and regenerated the delay-stability, transient-step and sampled small-gain CSV outputs. Earlier versions of these three result tables are superseded.
coordinate_metric_interpretation: M and D matrix norms/eigenvalues depend on mixed generalized-coordinate units (m/rad); report these as numeric diagnostics under the declared coordinate convention, not as single SI-unit measurements.
